ShortDescription.Value: Vanilla milestones arrive too quickly. Slow progression and make population growth matter.

Publish.LongDescription:
## Why this mod exists
Vanilla milestone progression can move so quickly that unlocks arrive before a city has had time to grow into them. XP from roads, services, happiness, and other sources stacks up fast, making progression feel less connected to the population you are actually building.
Progression Controls lets you slow that pace and make new population records the foundation of milestone XP. It keeps the game's milestones, rewards, development points, loan limits, and unlocks intact.
## Features
- Award XP when the city reaches a new all-time population record. - Scale positive XP already queued for the game from 0% to 100%. - Accumulate fractional population XP without losing progress to rounding. - Batch population XP notifications from 1 to 256 awards per in-game day. - Apply every change prospectively without recalculating existing XP. - Disable the mod to leave future queued XP unscaled and make it dormant.
## Presets
- **Population Balanced:** 1.5 XP per new record resident plus 50% vanilla XP. - **Population Heavy:** 1.5 XP per new record resident plus 25% vanilla XP. - **Population Only:** 1.5 XP per new record resident with vanilla XP suppressed.
Show Advanced exposes an XP-per-new-resident slider from 0 to 10 in 0.25 increments, the vanilla XP multiplier, population update responsiveness, and population XP notification frequency.
## Save safety
Progression Controls adds no required components to city saves. Earned XP and milestones remain normal game state, and cities continue loading after the mod is disabled or removed.
## Compatibility
Unlimited Money is supported. Unlock All bypasses milestone progression, so XP changes have no meaningful visible effect. Positive XP from another mod may be scaled when queued before Progression Controls, depending on update order. Other mods that add or intercept XP or replace milestone behavior are unsupported.
Publish.ChangeLog:
Initial public release:
- Population Balanced, Population Heavy, Population Only, and Custom rules. - Population XP at new all-time population records. - Shared-queue XP scaling from 0% to 100%. - Save-safe population XP notification batching. - Save-safe external checkpoints and dormant disable behavior.
